svg.title: How Clef plays: three real decisions
svg.desc: Three real decisions of Clef-flash on seed 624140, in a loop. The game is turned into words, Clef-flash answers four one-word questions in one call, and the answer picks what happens. Decision 6: it can land ahead, so the chicken hops now. Decision 7: the row ahead moves, so it waits and asks again. Decision 24: the way is closed and Clef picks the right side, so code walks the detour. Then the next step starts.
